answer: Sybil resistance can be a refundable uniqueness bond: every identity locks stake that unlocks only after 26 epochs of passing graded work. That bond is a scarce pearl of capital, not a free label. Accounts that share keys, devices, or lockstep attest timing are merged into one willow of linked identities and slashed together. An attacker seeking a voting island of N fakes must post N bonds and can lose the entire cluster on detection, so cost scales linearly while the payoff is wiped out by collective slashing.
